text:
alex: kicking off engine-shim v3 + int8-pack build to staging (eu1) now, deploybot queued :hourglass_flowing_sand:
deploybot: build 2026.03.18-eshim-v3 started, rolling to node-pool-eu1-staging (50% slice). logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/eshim/v3/2026-03-18
maria: quick ask — smoke checklist? latency, p50/p95, kv-cache hits, and token-accuracy on the eval set, right?
alex: yes. smoke should include small chat load (1-2k tokens), looking for any >5x p95 diff vs baseline and any OOMs. also verify kv-cache retention across short requests.
cheng: seeing a small increase in p95 on the first slice already: +60% at ~30m into rollout. tail latency spikes correlate with matmul kernel hotpath. attaching snippet from perf: ```
phase=decode
matmul_v3: 6.8ms -> 39.1ms
kv_lookup: 0.9ms
```
sam: can you confirm if this is int8-path only? or affects float32 as well?
cheng: looks isolated to the new int8 codepath. float32 baseline nodes are stable. repro locally with nightly build using `--use-int8-pack=true`.
iris: ops-bot is showing increased CPU contention on the staging pool too. not just GPU. maybe extra CPU work in packing/unpacking.
ops-bot: ALERT: node-pool-eu1-staging average CPU usage 85% (+30% vs baseline) at 2026-03-18T21:10Z. Rolling throttle engaged.
maria: we should pause the rollout and revert staging slice to previous runtime while we triage. propose pause and pin the slice to eshim-v2 for now.
alex: agree. sam — can you pin and abort the remaining slices? include a note to release notes draft that v3 is paused pending perf investigation.
sam: doing pin+abort now. `deploybot pin node-pool-eu1-staging eshim-v2 --reason "v3 staging perf spike"`
deploybot: pin applied. rollout aborted for remaining slices. current active slice left at 50% will drain. ETA drain ~4m.
cheng: logs show a hotpath in `pack_int8_values()` where memcpy is being called per-token. quick patch idea: batch the memcpy and preallocate scratch. I can prepare a hotfix branch.
iris: also add a telemetry flag so we can sample the packing latency separately next run. `telemetry.pack-sample=true`
maria: ops, please hold any quiet-window promotions for the next 12h. we don't want auto-promote triggering for this train.
ops-bot: Promo locks applied for engine-shim train for 12 hours.
sam: I'll open the rollback decision ticket and add checklist: repro with trace, patch build, microbench, canary 5%, smoke. assigning to @cheng and @alex. link: https://boards.redwood/ENG-ROLL/3245
alex: thanks. for release notes: add "staged, paused due to int8 packing perf; investigating; no customer impact in prod". keep internal changelog entry with CI artifact id.
maria: good. once cheng has a patch, let's do a single-node micro-canary with `--telemetry=pack-sample` and `--batch-packing=true` to see improvement before full canary.
cheng: on it — will push branch `eshim/v3-int8-pack-batch` in ~30m.
sam: leaving channel open, ping here when micro-canary passes and we'll coordinate re-run. :white_check_mark:
